name: Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)
description: Establishes uniform digital operational resilience requirements for EU financial entities and their critical third-party ICT service providers (including AI and cloud vendors).

requirements.title: ICT Risk Management Framework
requirements.normalized_requirement: Financial entities shall have a sound, comprehensive and well-documented ICT risk management framework as part of their overall risk management system, covering AI-enabled financial algorithms and processing systems.
requirements.applicability: Financial entities operating in the EU
requirements.implementation_guidance: Document digital operational resilience protocols for automated trading and credit decision AI.
evidence_expected: DORA ICT Risk Management Framework Policy

requirements.title: Management of ICT Third-Party AI/Cloud Risk
requirements.normalized_requirement: Financial entities shall manage ICT third-party risk as an integral component of ICT risk, maintaining an information register of all contractual arrangements on the use of ICT services provided by third-party providers (including foundation model vendors).
requirements.applicability: Financial entities relying on external AI/cloud providers
requirements.implementation_guidance: Audit AI vendor contracts, require clear service level agreements, and maintain a register of third-party model providers.
